paite: Huan David in tang vum kahkhiakna akhen zek nung in, ngai in, Mephibosheth sikha Ziba in sabiltung nih toh ana dawn hi. Sabiltung nihte'n tanghou beu zanih, grep phoukeu bawk zakhat, nipithei zakhat leh uain thawl khat apua uhi.
heading: David Leh Ziba

paite: Kumpipa'n Ziba kiang ah, "Hiaite bangchidan ahia?" achi hi. Ziba in, "Sabiltungte kumpipa inkuanpihte tuanna ding ahi, Tanghou leh nipitheite tangvalte nek ding; uain bel gamdai a bah peuhmahte dawn ding ahi," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n, "Ahihleh na pu tapa koi ah?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jerusalem ah a-om. 'Tuni in Israel inkote'n ka pa lalgam ahon pekik nawn ding uh, chi a angaihtuah ziak in,' " achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Ziba kiang ah, "Ngai in, Mephibosheth thil neih tengteng nang a ahi vekta," achi hi. Ziba in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na mitmuh a deihsakna mu ding in kingainiamtak in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
Kumpipa David, Bahurim atun in, ngai in, Saul inkote lak a mi Gera tapa, amin Shimei ahong pawtkhia a; hamsia lou kawmkawm in ahong paitou hi.
heading: David Leh Shimei

paite: Suang in David adeng a, kumpipa David sikha tengteng leng; mi tengteng leh sepaih hat tengteng ataklam leh veilam ah a-om uhi.
Shimei in hamsiat in hichi in achi, "Paimang vengveng in, paimang vengveng in, nang sisan suah hat leh Belial mipa:

Asik a vai na hawm Saul inkote tengteng sisan TOUPA'N na tung ah ahon kiksak nawnta. TOUPA'N gam na tapa Absalom ana pe khinta. Ngai in, sisan suah hatmi na hih ziak in nangmah siatna na kitun ve," achi hi.
Huchi in Zeruiah tapa Abishai in kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai ui sisa in toupa, ka pu hamsiat mawkmawk ahia? Ka kuantou ding a alu ka tansak mai ding?" achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Nou Zeruiah tapate aw, nou na hon theihsak ding uh bang a-om a? TOUPA'N akiang a, David hamsiat in, achihleh ahamsiat ahi mai kei dia. Bangziak a huchibang a hih kua'n achi dia?" achi hi.

David in Abishai leh asikhate tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, ka tapa, ka gil a gah mahmah in hon thah atum. Hiai Benjamin mi'n nak tup sem na'n chia! Bangmah loh kei unla, hamsia ahihleh loh hen. TOUPA hihsak ahi,
TOUPA'N ka haksatna ahon mu dia, TOUPA'N tuni a hon hamsiat ahoih lam in hon thuk nawn kha maithei hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in David leh amite lampi ah apai zel uh. Shimei bel agal tang pang ah apai zel a, apai kawm in ahamsiat zom zel a, suang in adeng a, leivui in atheh hi.
Huchi in kumpipa leh akiang a mi om tengteng Aiphim atungta uh. Huchi in huai ah akhawl tawldam uhi.
Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ahoh ua, alak uah Ahithophel leng atel hi.
heading: Jerusalem Ah Absalom

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Arki mi Hushai, David lawm, Absalom kiang atun in Absalom kiang ah, "Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen, Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen," achi hi.
Absalom in Hushai kiang ah, "Hichibang ahi maw na lawm na hehpihna dan? Bangziak a na lawm kiang a hoh lou?" achi hi.
Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Ka hoh kei ding. TOUPA leh hiai mite leh Israel mi tengteng atelpa uh thuthu in ka om dia, akiang ah ka om zaw ding.
Kua nna ka sem dia? Atapa ma ah nna ka sem ding ahi kei maw? Na pa ma a ka sep bang in nangmah ma ah ka sem ding,” achi hi.
Absalom in Ahithophel kiang ah, "Bangchi in i hih diam aw, na ngaihdan gen dih ve," achi hi.
Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Na pa mei, inn ngak a akoihte kithuahpih in. Israel mi tengteng in na pa'n nang hon mudah chih ana za ding ua; nang lam a pang tengteng khut ahat ding," achi hi.
Absalom a ding in inn tung ah puanin akai uh. Huchi in Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in apa meite akithuahpih hi.
Huai lai in Ahithophel lem theihnate, Pathian thu dongpa lemtheihna bang ahi a; huchi mah bang in David leh Absalom in leng Ahithophel ana ngai uhi.
